content_text:
I recently came across a situation where, if the FPS is set to “variable,” adjusting the ISO seems to have no effect on the exposure of the image (the simulation does not change).
However, when the FPS is set to “fix,” changing the ISO does affect the image exposure (the simulation is active).
Has anyone experienced this scenario? It would be really helpful if someone could explain this.
